payload.body: De-risked: FrickSchema.hash is a HAND-AUTHORED opaque string (e.g. "rangercrm-0.1.0", foundation: "frick-foundation-empty-0.1.0"). No content-hash function exists anywhere in the repo — the only op ever performed on hash is string equality (see internal/rust-rewrite/maps/07-schema-pipeline.md §4.1; docs/schema-author-tutorial.md's 'content hash' claim is aspirational/wrong). The Rust DSL just carries the string through. NOTE: validateSchema does stableClone normalization (recursive key sort + drop undefined) — wire encodings of the schema use SORTED key order; Rust serializers must match.
